protocol.calibration: Independent iid with-replacement prefixes from the fixed target empirical mixture; estimator receives scores and counts only
protocol.independence: New calibration RNG, independent of saved adaptation RNG conditional on the fixed feature pool; no new official split
protocol.initialization: Original saved initialization; it is never recentered using the new calibration
protocol.source_risk: Training-label risk endpoints retained: target labels not used for field fitting or these endpoints
protocol.oracle_risk: Target-label endpoints retained solely to isolate field calibration: not an unlabeled risk predictor
protocol.uncertainty: Root Wald interval is asymptotic, estimated curvature/noise are plug-in; direction interval varies root only
protocol.variance: Do not inflate actual SGD seed variance: calibration affects the predictor, not the saved initialization
protocol.aggregation: Scores average each successful calibration separately; curves average successful calibrations only, availability reported; all reuse the same saved SGD paths
